assertion: Vertical SVG text uses the central baseline and vertical advances. CJK stays upright, mixed Latin rotates, explicit orientation overrides it, and text anchors and y lists address the vertical inline axis.

browser.reason: Chrome and Firefox agree on central baselines, mixed and explicit glyph orientation, vertical anchoring and physical y lists. WebKit uses different fallback vertical metrics. Chrome is selected after checking font origins and character positioning. Reviewed native differences follow glyph edges and subpixel font-origin rounding (4571 pixels); vertical advances, y lists and textLength are checked numerically.
